profile.visual_desc: Athletic woman with long blonde ponytail. Wears a dark blue tunic, single red pauldron on the left, and grey greaves with teal wraps.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Close-up facing left. Features wavy blonde hair, determined dark eyes, red lips, and a high-collared dark teal outfit.
profile.weapon_desc: Unarmed martial arts style focusing on energy-infused strikes from the right fist.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Low athletic stance with arms bent at the sides, showing back and red shoulder guard.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight back and coils the body. The right arm pulls low toward the hip to gather power.
profile.step3_impact: Springs forward with an upward punch. Large golden energy crescent erupts, sweeping from floor level toward the upper-left.
profile.step4_finish: Holds high follow-through pose with right arm extended upward. Golden energy trail thins and fades into the air.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 originates from the fist's low point and curves upward, matching the uppercut trajectory.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation adequately translates the reference. Movement and VFX alignment are sufficiently consistent with the source sequence.
